maintenanceReason: The v0.12 phase gate froze a global repository snapshot (432 paths) at registration. Two later, human-approved presentation changes (README showcase rewrite, .gitignore runtime-artifact hardening) drifted that snapshot without touching any input capable of changing the claim-impact benchmark. This record keeps the original gate byte-immutable and separates it from the active semantic conformance scope, so non-semantic repository drift is reported instead of being silently tolerated or retroactively rewritten.

activeConformancePolicy.rule: A path is a semantic input only if an executable, fixture, prompt or dependency-lock artifact of the claim-impact pipeline can reach it. Everything else is repository presentation or unrelated product code: its drift is reported, never blocking.

boundary.testSurfaces: excluded by construction: the repository keeps tests in sibling directories (research/claim-revision-test, agent/test), which no rule matches. Tests are consumers of the policy, not semantic inputs.
boundary.repositoryPresentation: reported as drift and never blocking.
boundary.noCatchAll: no rule uses a repository-wide wildcard; widening the scope is an explicit, reviewable edit of this file.
